product.name: Co-Analyst
product.description: An AI tool that extracts and consolidates insights from public company filings and transcripts to provide precise, sourced answers for institutional investors.

product.name: The Co-Analyst
product.description: The Co-Analyst is an AI assistant that turns unstructured financial documents into cited answers for equity research and risk analysis.

product.name: Market Intelligence
product.description: Market Intelligence is a financial research platform that combines fundamentals and AI retrieval to surface relevant insights on public companies.

identifier.value: Forensic Risk Scores and Red Flags

product.name: Forensic Risk Scores and Red Flags
product.description: Proprietary AI-generated scores and alerts that assess the likelihood of fraud, SEC enforcement, and other financial risks in public companies.

identifier.value: Earnings Call and Company Background Summaries

product.name: Earnings Call and Company Background Summaries
product.description: AI-generated summaries of earnings calls and company backgrounds that highlight key financial metrics and guidance.

product.name: Forensic Risk
product.description: Forensic Risk provides machine-learned risk scores that flag litigation, accounting, governance, and executive turnover issues in public companies.
